'''G2 Spider Shell''' was the name of a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] [[Armor/Legends|armor]] model created by [[Baktoid Armor Workshop/Legends|Baktoid Armor Workshop]] during the final years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. The G2 Spider Shell armor could be used on land vehicles as well as smaller starship designs.
